test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

Their relationship is quite ______ (cordial).
solution: The correct answer is '**warm**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**cordial**' is '**warm**'. • **Cordial**: pleasant and friendly. (ख़ुशनुमा और मैत्रीपूर्ण) • *Example: a **cordial** greeting/smile...* • **Warm**: friendly, kind and pleasant. (मैत्रीपूर्ण, स्‍नेहमय और मनभावन) • Example: I was given a very warm welcome. **Correct Answer:__** *warm* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **hostile**: having very strong feelings against somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति अत्‍यंत उग्र भावनाओं वाला; प्रतिकूल भाव) • **formal**: official. (औपचारिक, विधि-अनुकूल, आधिकारिक रूप से) • **artful**: clever at getting what you want, perhaps by not telling the truth. (चतुर, चालाक, संभवतः धूर्त तरीक़े अपनाने वाला) 1ae:Tb91, The correct answer is '**Conservative**'.
